remnicConfig.$comment: Pinned Remnic config for the MemCorrect v1 lab run (issue #1725 / plan item 2b). Used with `remnic bench run memcorrect-v1 --runtime-profile real --remnic-config <this file> --memcorrect-adapter remnic` on the RTX 3090 lab host. The real profile preserves Remnic's shipped defaults (full fact pipeline, contradiction detection, tombstones, correction contract); this file pins only the local-LLM endpoint and the extraction gates so the run is hermetic and reproducible without environment-variable templating.
